# Repository instructions

Read [RULES.md](../RULES.md) and [HANDOFF.md](../HANDOFF.md) before working. RULES.md is the single source of project rules.

Include a substantive HANDOFF.md update in every repository-changing commit: changes, evidence, limitations, and next steps. Read [development workflow](../docs/development-workflow.md) for validation. Never represent offline checks as successful game tests.
